_comment: Official Analogue Pocket firmware releases. Source: https://www.analogue.co/support/pocket/firmware . The download URL is the stable analogue.co redirect endpoint; it 308-redirects to assets.analogue.co. MD5 is published on each firmware page and is used to validate downloads. Update this file when Analogue ships a new firmware - no code change required.

releases.notes: GB/GBC save-state export fix; TG16 Hucard fixes; expanded Switch/8BitDo/Wii controller support.
